author.name: Angela Davis
author.heading: About Angela Davis
author.bio: Angela Y. Davis is a scholar and activist whose work connects feminism, racial justice and the prison system. A distinguished professor emerita at UC Santa Cruz, she helped found Critical Resistance and has written books including Women, Race, and Class and Are Prisons Obsolete?.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Davis begins with a young man recognizing her only as the Afro after a performance involving incarcerated women. She uses that encounter to examine how historical images can reduce a politics of liberation to a fashion memory, and how easily their original context is lost.
